title: Date Picker
api:
interface DatePickerProps {
  value?: Date | null
  defaultValue?: Date | null
  onValueChange?: (value: Date | null) => void
  label?: string
  placeholder?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  loading?: boolean
  readOnly?: boolean
  required?: boolean
  name?: string
  form?: string
  minDate?: Date
  maxDate?: Date
  locale?: string
  clearable?: boolean
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  /** Customize the popup calendar without replacing value, constraints, or selection behavior. */
  calendarOptions?: CalendarDisplayOptions
  className?: string
  id?: string
  'aria-label'?: string
  'aria-labelledby'?: string
  'aria-describedby'?: string
  'aria-invalid'?: AriaAttributes['aria-invalid']
}

function DatePicker({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  label,
  placeholder: placeholderProp,
  disabled = false,
  loading = false,
  readOnly = false,
  required = false,
  name,
  form,
  minDate,
  maxDate,
  locale: localeProp,
  clearable = true,
  size = 'md',
  calendarOptions,
  className,
  id,
  'aria-label': ariaLabel,
  'aria-labelledby': labelledBy,
  'aria-describedby': describedBy,
  'aria-invalid': invalid,
}: DatePickerProps);

props.name: calendarOptions
props.description: Customize the popup calendar without replacing value, constraints, or selection behavior.

notes: value/onValueChange use Date|null, not a date string. Name submits a local calendar date; handle timezone requirements in application logic.
DatePicker has no outer size prop. Set calendarOptions.size to adjust its calendar; use minDate/maxDate for bounds.
